title: Corporate Wellness Partnership: household add-on eligibility, membership bundling floor, and onboarding fee waiver by tier
content:
This document covers the Corporate Wellness Partnership's basis for whether an enrolled employee may also hold household add-ons at the bundled discount, the minimum club membership tier ladder rank the employee must already hold to bundle this enrollment, and whether the club's standard membership enrollment fee is waived for this tier.

| Tier | Employee may also hold household add-ons at the bundled discount | Minimum club membership tier ladder rank required to bundle | Standard membership enrollment fee waived |
|---|---|---|---|
| Startup Partner | No | 0 | Yes |
| Small Business Partner | Yes | 0 | Yes |
| Mid-Market Partner | Yes | 0 | Yes |
| Enterprise Partner | Yes | 0 | Yes |
| Municipal Partner | Yes | 0 | Yes |
| Nonprofit Partner | Yes | 0 | Yes |

Every tier sets its minimum required club membership tier ladder rank at zero, meaning any active club membership on file qualifies for bundling under the membership-bundling requirement stated in a separate document.
